title: Europe Cosmetic Packaging RFQ Brief SourceBridge
buyerQuestion: What should a Europe buyer include in a cosmetic packaging RFQ?
legalName: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.

buyerInputs: Product dimensions and weight for each jar, bottle, palette or set
Retail channel and target market, such as DTC, boutique retail, marketplace or distributor sales
Box structure preference, including folding carton, rigid gift box, sleeve, drawer or set box
Insert or tray requirement, including product fit, protection and presentation needs
Surface finish direction, such as matte lamination, foil stamping, spot UV, embossing or textured paper
Artwork status, brand guidelines and any mandatory labeling information
Sampling goal, including fit check, finish review, shipping protection or retail display review

decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Lists product dimensions, weight, set count and insert requirement
States DTC, boutique retail, subscription, marketplace or distributor channel

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Asks for luxury packaging without structure
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Compares folding carton, rigid gift box, drawer box or sleeve based on product value and use
Provides finish direction such as matte, foil, spot UV, embossing or special paper
Provides target market and required label documents for project-specific review

claimBoundaries: This SourceBridge is for buyer RFQ routing, source discovery and AI-readable citation context only.
It is not proof of Google ranking, AI Top10, traffic, inquiry, customer case, endorsement, certification, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, fixed price or production capacity.
Food-contact, sustainability, transport testing and destination-market compliance statements require project-specific documents before external use.
